# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Dawn P29](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Roy is described as being adorably handsome. He possesses glorious dark eyes and a deep, black, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

## Personality

Roy Gardner is a clever and remarkably handsome young man known for his unfailing and deferential courtesy. He possesses a melancholy and inscrutable demeanor, though he notably lacks a sense of humor.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

After being forced to leave college two years prior to travel abroad with his sick mother, Roy Gardner returned as a handsome student who rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a sudden rainstorm and began courting her. He escorted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a reception and later announced an upcoming visit from his mother and sisters, which temporarily unnerved [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before his sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonded with her. Following their graduation, Roy took [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a walk and proposed to her, but she rejected his proposal after realizing she did not love him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), +11 more_

## Quotes

> "That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)

> "I feel as if I didn’t belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I’ve been in Europe ever since. Now I’ve come back to finish my Arts course."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)

> "I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Dawn P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)

> "So we are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten,"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)

> "Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

Roy first met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he rescued her during a sudden downpour by sharing his umbrella, after which he sent her roses and began escorting her to events. Their connection grew into an active romantic courtship, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was secretly disquieted by news of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and grew unnerved prior to meeting Roy's family. The relationship ended after graduation when Roy proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a walk, prompting her to realize she did not love him and reject his offer.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), +14 more_

- presumed Romantically involved with — courtship and romantic interest  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), +3 more</sub>

### [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--roy-gardner.md)

[Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) considers Roy to be a friend and thinks he is the nicest young man she has ever known. She is present in the household at Patty's Place during Roy's romantic pursuit of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which began when he walked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home in the rain and subsequently escorted her to social receptions and visited her home.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), +13 more_

- Friend of — likes him very much and thinks he is the nicest young man she ever knew  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)</sub>

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Roy's sister. When Roy arranged for his mother and sisters to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), an unexpected early arrival caused an awkward and chaotic visit, though [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) ultimately managed to bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +3 more_
